title: Axon downloads and executes rtkx without an integrity check
summary: The rtk-install and auto-bootstrap paths download an rtkx binary and execute it without checking a checksum, signature or attestation.

severity.rationale: The missing check weakens defense against a separate supply-chain compromise. The upstream-compromise prerequisite makes this a hardening issue under the feed rubric.

affected.note: The advisory lists <=0.1.0 and no patched version.

exposure: Exploitation requires compromise of the rtkx release pipeline or release credentials. The advisory describes a missing control, not an observed distribution compromise.

params.instructions: Check axon-mcp version and whether the documented exposure conditions apply.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Avoid running the unverified bootstrap binary until its provenance and integrity can be established. The reviewed advisory provides no fixed release.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Inspect the installed bootstrap path and confirm integrity verification occurs before any downloaded binary executes.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
